recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下可見一個細胞質藍色、含多個分開圓核的大細胞（左中央，推測為核分離的異常巨核細胞），紅血球系前驅細胞中有雙核與核形不規則者，核染色質呈類巨母細胞樣；這些雙系異常變化支持 RCC 的診斷。
features: Large cell with blue granular cytoplasm and multiple separated round nuclei, suggestive of a dysplastic megakaryocyte
Erythroid precursors with binucleation and irregular nuclear contours
Megaloblastoid chromatin in some erythroid precursors
Granulocytic precursors at various stages, including a cell with coarse orange-brown granules
Occasional small hypolobated or bilobed nuclei
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a cellular field of mixed hematopoietic precursors. A large cell with blue granular cytoplasm and several widely separated round nuclei is present, suggestive of a dysplastic megakaryocyte. Erythroid precursors show binucleation, irregular nuclear contours, and megaloblastoid chromatin, and granulocytic precursors are present at various maturation stages without an increase in blasts in this field. These dysplastic features, in a child with persistent cytopenia and a hypocellular marrow, are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and corrects with vitamin replacement.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19 infection or drug-related dyserythropoiesis
ddx.vs: Reactive dyserythropoiesis is transient, may show giant pronormoblasts with parvovirus, and lacks megakaryocytic dysplasia.
Fanconi anemia can show similar dysplasia, so chromosome breakage testing is required.
